goal: Customize validation and normalization of the postal code and phone on saved customer addresses.

absentMeans.description: The platform uses the standard normalization and validation for the supplied address policy.

whyThisDefault: Hosts can choose address formats required by their delivery integrations while preserving existing behavior by default.

frozenOn: Existing saved addresses and captured delivery destinations keep their stored values.

runtime.reason: The callbacks are executable host code.

goal: Change how checkout shipping rates and quote promotions are calculated or connect a shipping carrier (carrier, shipping provider, courier, rate calculation).
whyThisDefault: With no resolveQuoteShippingPromotions callback bound (for example via createQuoteShippingPromotions from @openlup/platform/promotions), quotes perform no shipping-rate or shipping-promotion evaluation by default.

effect.appliesTo: New checkout quotes call the bound resolveQuoteShippingPromotions callback from @openlup/platform/pricing (composed via createQuoteShippingPromotions from @openlup/platform/promotions) during quote calculation.
frozenOn: Saved checkout quotes and order drafts retain their recorded shipping amounts and terms.

runtime.reason: The callback is executable server code implementing resolveQuoteShippingPromotions / createQuoteShippingPromotions.

goal: Set the legacy flat shipping fee in currency minor units when threshold shipping policy is absent (flat shipping, legacy shipping rate, delivery fee).
whyThisDefault: Zero minor units preserves the historical absent-row fallback in commerce_settings and quoteShippingPolicy when neither a flat rate nor a threshold shipping policy is configured.

effect.appliesTo: Legacy flat-rate fallback read from commerce_settings.value_minor (and managed via ShippingRateDataPort). Used only when no active shipping-policy.v1 threshold policy is supplied; ignored when threshold shipping policy such as the starter's offer.shippingMinor (shipping-policy.v1) is active.
frozenOn: Saved checkout quotes and order drafts retain their recorded shipping amounts and terms.

runtime.reason: Updated through ShippingRateDataPort.setShippingFlatMinor when threshold shipping policy is not active.

goal: Support optional postal codes and address regions.

runtime.reason: The native address contract requires a postal code and has no region field.
